---
title: About
subtitle: 'All Data Are Local: Introduction to Data Literacy'
---

This two-day block course is part of **PLAY 1 / Data Literacy** in Data Design + Art.

Moritz Mähr teaches the course. Write to <moritz.maehr@gmail.com> with questions about the content.

The course gives 12 hours of contact time, as two days of six sessions of 60 minutes. Day 1 runs on 5 October 2026 and Day 2 on 12 October 2026.

The main text is Yanni Alexander Loukissas, _All Data Are Local_. The statistics resource is _Introduction to Modern Statistics (2e)_.

## Teaching approach

The course uses a flipped structure.

**In class:** critical data literacy, close reading, discussion, application, and feedback.

**Between the two days:** basic statistics and standard data displays through self-study.

The course treats data as material for knowledge and design. It asks students to look behind a table or chart and study the conditions that produced it.

## Scope

This is not a complete statistics, programming, database, or data-law course. It provides a foundation for later work in data analysis, information design, visualization, coding, and data-based art.

The central principle is:

> To understand a dataset, we must also understand its setting.
